integrity_notes: Universal proof is given separately from finite consistency checks; no original maximum-clique theorem is claimed; the published-literature novelty check is not independent certification.
limitations: Finite Brandt semigroups of index size at least two. Explicit enumerators require two input polynomials for the finite structure group. The result does not classify commuting sets of general Rees matrix semigroups.
title: Maximal commutative subsemigroups and complete clique enumerators of finite Brandt semigroups
